test_completion_with_retries: test the completion_with_retries function to verify it passes num_retries and max_retries to the underlying completion call
test_responses_with_retries: test the responses_with_retries function to verify it passes num_retries and max_retries to the underlying responses call
test_completion_retry_policy: test the completion function with a custom RetryPolicy to verify per-error-type retry counts like ContentPolicyViolationErrorRetries
test_completion_max_retries: test the completion function with max_retries parameter to verify retry behavior on failed requests
test_responses_retry_on_auth_error: test the responses API to verify it retries on authentication errors using the responses_with_retries decorator
